changelog:
v2.12.0 - DLS Pad replaced by DLS LIVE BOOST.

- The floating gamepad is REMOVED completely (no more accessibility touch injection or overlay).
- NEW Live Boost: watches for the game in the foreground. The moment DLS is on screen, every background app freezes so the live match gets all CPU/RAM/network.
- AUTOMATIC RESTORE: leave the match, close the game, or stop the service - everything returns to normal instantly, double-checked so nothing flickers.
- No-stuck guarantees: only apps IT froze are restored (your own frozen apps untouched); leftovers from crashed sessions release on start; keyboard/launcher/system/game/Empire never frozen; if Shizuku dies mid-match everything restores and boost stops.
- Needs Usage Access granted once (to detect when the game opens/closes) + Shizuku running.
